issues.description: Method Pneumatic.raisePressure(int): the UML in problem_statement.md declares raisePressure(pressureIncrease: int) with return type void, but the solution repository's Pneumatic interface declares boolean raisePressure(int), while the solution's implementing classes LaunchedDropdownTower and LaunchedRollerCoaster implement raisePressure(int) with a void return type. The template Pneumatic.java is empty and does not provide the correct signature for students. This mismatch between UML, template, and solution artifacts will cause compilation errors and confuse students about the correct method return type.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type of Pneumatic.raisePressure(int) consistent across all artifacts. Preferred fix to match the UML: change the Pneumatic interface in both solution and template repositories to declare void raisePressure(int pressureIncrease), and ensure the interface file in the template contains that signature to guide students. The existing implementing classes already use void and will then be correct. Alternatively, if a boolean result was intended, update the UML to indicate a boolean return type and change the implementing classes to return boolean accordingly.
